heard: The book lists the names of the returning Israelites who settled on their land Judah went into exile in Babylon But now the first return to their towns From the Levites came Shemaiah, son of Hashab, of the line of Merari And Bakbakar stood with Heresh and Galo, Mataniah, son of Micah, was there Baqbaqar, Hirish, Galil, and Matanya Sons of Micah, son of Zitri, son of Asaph Serving the ten
